description: Run what a schedule runs now, without waiting for its time: its saved test, or its suite as one batch (Run now in the Schedules view). Its timing does not change, and it runs whether it is paused or not. Returns the batch_id and the run numbers; follow them with list_runs. Uses conversation credits and calls the agent.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

schedule.description: The schedule's id, as list_schedules shows it.
schedule.title: Schedule

name: run_schedule_now
